## ✨ Added

- **Full-text search (Apache Tika), optional.** The new **Full-text search (Tika)** dropdown and **Tika server URL** field turn on search inside your files (PDF, Word, Excel, ...), not just their names, by pointing OpenCloud's search extractor at a separate Apache Tika container (image `apache/tika`, port `9998`; a `-full` tag also OCRs scanned images). It is off by default, and only files uploaded or changed after you turn it on get their content indexed.

## ⚡ Improved

- README gained a **Full-text search (Apache Tika)** section, clarifying that OpenCloud already has built-in name and metadata search and that Tika is the optional content extractor, with the Community Applications setup steps.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The web office editor was blocked by OpenCloud's own Content-Security-Policy.** Setting an **Office document server URL** did not add that server to OpenCloud's `frame-src`/`img-src` directives, so the browser silently refused to show the editor. The wrapper now adds it automatically, unless you point `PROXY_CSP_CONFIG_FILE_LOCATION` at a CSP file of your own, which it leaves alone.
